mapper.sql: id, create_user_id, create_user_name, create_time, update_user_id, update_user_name, update_time, version, is_deleted, supplier_id, supplier_name, type, disabled, auth_status, auth_time
mapper.select: SELECT tls.id, tla.id AS authId, tla.main_id AS mainId, tls.supplier_id, tls.supplier_name, tls.auth_status, tls.disabled, tla.logistics_platform FROM transfer_logistics_supplier tls INNER JOIN transfer_logistics_auth tla ON tls.id = tla.main_id AND tla.is_deleted=FALSE WHERE tls.is_deleted=FALSE

SELECT lc.id, lc.name, lc.code, lc.disabled FROM transfer_logistics_channel lc INNER JOIN transfer_logistics_supplier ls ON lc.main_id = ls.id and ls.is_deleted = false WHERE lc.is_deleted=false AND ls.supplier_id=#{supplierId}
